eir.0303 = {
	type = character_event
	title = eir.0303.t
	desc = eir.0303.desc
	theme = learning

	trigger = {
		has_variable = eir_recelt
		eir_has_celtic_britain_counties_trigger = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		random_sub_realm_county = {
			limit = {
				title_province ?= { geographical_region = world_europe_west_britannia }
				has_county_modifier = eir_hedge_schools_modifier
			}
			save_scope_as = eir_unrest_county
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:eir_unrest_county } }
			random_sub_realm_county = {
				limit = {
					title_province ?= { geographical_region = world_europe_west_britannia }
					culture ?= { OR = { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_goidelic has_cultural_pillar = heritage_brythonic } }
				}
				save_scope_as = eir_unrest_county
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0303.a
		stress_impact = {
			generous = minor_stress_impact_loss
			greedy = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		remove_short_term_gold = minor_gold_value
		add_trait_xp = { trait = lifestyle_poet value = 15 }
		scope:eir_unrest_county = { add_county_modifier = { modifier = eir_hedge_schools_modifier years = 10 } }
		add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
	}

	option = {
